title: Billing Plan Terms for Manufactured Home Insurance Policyholders
content:
The premium of a Manufactured Home Insurance policy is billed under the payment plan chosen on the policy, with a policy fee for each term.

## Terms

**Policy fee.** The policy fee is charged once per term, when the term is bound or renewed, and is fully earned.

**Annual plan.** The whole premium is one installment due on the effective date.

**Semi-annual plan.** Two equal installments are due, on the effective date and six months later, each with the semi-annual installment fee.

**Monthly EFT plan.** The first installment is the monthly EFT first-payment percentage of the premium, and the rest is spread over the remaining ten monthly drafts, each with the monthly EFT installment fee.

**Rounding of installments.** Each installment is rounded half up to the cent, and the last installment absorbs any difference.

**Loan escrow plan.** Available only when Hearthstone Home Finance is loss payee and the loan is escrowed. The whole term premium is billed to the escrow and remitted by Hearthstone Home Finance; no installment fee applies.

**Application of payments.** Payments are applied to the oldest installment first, and are made through the accepted payment channels.

**Changes to the loss payee or the plan.** The loss payee and the payment plan may be changed only on a policy that is in force; a plan change takes effect from the next installment.

**Premium balance.** The amount the insured owes on the policy is the premium installments, policy fees, installment fees, endorsement premium and refunds issued, less payments, escrow remittances and return premium.

## Installment illustrations (hypothetical annual premiums)

*Semi-annual, annual premium $725.* Two installments of $362.50, the first due on the effective date and the second six months later, each with the semi-annual installment fee.

*Monthly EFT, annual premium $600, first-payment percentage 16.67%.* First installment $100.02. The remaining $499.98 spread over ten drafts gives $49.998, rounded half up to $50.00 for each of the first nine drafts, $450.00 in all; the tenth draft absorbs the difference and is $49.98. Each of the ten drafts carries the monthly EFT installment fee.

*Loan escrow, annual premium $600.* The whole $600.00 is billed to the Hearthstone Home Finance escrow; no installment fee is added.

## Status table for changes to the loss payee or the payment plan

| Policy status, from the policy record | Loss payee or payment plan may be changed |
|---|---|
| In force | Yes |
| Quoted, bound, pending cancellation, cancelled, expired or non-renewed | No |

A plan change made while the policy is in force takes effect from the next installment.

## Basis Q&A

- *How often is the policy fee charged?* Once per term, when the term is bound or renewed; it is fully earned.
- *Which installment does a payment settle first?* The oldest installment.
- *May a policy whose loss payee is not Hearthstone Home Finance be on the loan escrow plan?* No; the plan is available only when Hearthstone Home Finance is loss payee and the loan is escrowed.
